_comment: Octail's own egg (LinuxGSM's wfserver settings and its Warfork server.cfg were read as a reference only). App 1136510 (Warfork Dedicated Server) from anonymous SteamCMD, the Linux build wf_server.x86_64 started with the game port, the HTTP download port and the slots on the start line, then basewf/octail.cfg: written once by the install and edited with the file parser before every start (name, public listing, join and rcon passwords, gametype, first map). The HTTP port (TCP, for map and demo downloads) is an automatic port variable (+1). Console input on stdin, quit stop, start detected by the game port (UDP), install sandbox defaults and resource hints. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times (its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration"), the steamcmd download times out and retries, and the install fails when the server binary is missing.
name: Warfork
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Warfork is a free, fast arena shooter on the Qfusion engine (a fork of Warsow): wall jumps, dashes and strafe jumps in duel, clan arena, capture the flag, bomb and more.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Warfork dedicated server (Octail's own install script; LinuxGSM's wfserver settings were read as a reference only).
# App 1136510, the Linux build, anonymous SteamCMD. Failures exit non-zero.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -uo pipefail

## anonymous login: the Warfork server needs no Steam account
STEAM_USER=anonymous

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps # steamapps: SteamCMD's disk write error when it is missing
if ! curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -o steamcmd.tar.gz \
    https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz; then
    echo "Installation failed: SteamCMD couldn't be downloaded."
    exit 1
fi
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

# SteamCMD fails otherwise, even running as root; the files are given to the server's user after the install.
chown -R root:root /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install the server with steamcmd (the Linux depot)
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
BETA=()
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || BETA=(-beta "${SRCDS_BETAID}")
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID}" "${BETA[@]}" validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 and 64 bit Steam client libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/wf_server.x86_64" || ! -d "/mnt/server/basewf" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Warfork dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi
chmod +x /mnt/server/wf_server.x86_64

## Octail: the server runs basewf/octail.cfg after its own configs; written once (a reinstall keeps yours). Octail sets
## the lines below from the Startup tab before every start; the line parser only replaces lines that are there.
if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/basewf/octail.cfg ]]; then
    cat > /mnt/server/basewf/octail.cfg <<'OCTAIL_EOF'
// Warfork server settings, run at every start after the game's own configs. Octail sets the lines below from the
// Startup tab before every start (keep them); add the game's other settings under them. Gametype configs in
// configs/server/gametypes/ can override some of these.
set sv_hostname "Warfork server"
set sv_public "1"
set password ""
set rcon_password ""
set g_gametype "ca"
set sv_defaultmap "wfdm1"
set g_maplist "wfdm1 wfdm2 wfdm4 wfdm6 wfdm7 wfdm9 wfdm10 wfdm11 wfdm12 wfdm13 wfdm14 wfdm16 wfdm17 wfdm18 wfdm19"
set g_maprotation "2"
set sv_http "1"
set sv_uploads "1"
set sv_uploads_from_server "1"
set g_autorecord "0"
OCTAIL_EOF
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server list (no double quotes or backslashes).

variables.name: Gametype
variables.description: ca (clan arena), dm (deathmatch), duel, ffa, tdm, ctf, ctftactics, bomb, da (duel arena) or headhunt.

variables.name: First Map
variables.description: The map loaded at start, such as wfdm1 or wfca1; after it the server follows g_maplist in basewf/octail.cfg.

variables.name: Public Server List
variables.description: 1 lists the server on the master servers; 0 keeps it off the list (players join by address).

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join. Empty = anyone can join. No double quotes or backslashes.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Optional: the remote console password (8-64 characters, no spaces, quotes, backslashes or semicolons). Hidden once saved. Empty = rcon off.

variables.name: HTTP Port
variables.description: Warfork's HTTP server (TCP): players download maps and demos from it. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: The Steam app id of the Warfork dedicated server.

variables.name: Beta Branch
variables.description: Optional: a Steam beta branch of the server; empty for the public build. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD before every start (1), or start the installed files (0). Players can only join a server of their own game version.
